+ Poppins Black: https://drfcdoakhkresrzk.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/fonts/poppins-black/Poppins-Black.ttf
+ Poppins variants: Multiple weights and styles available
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Implementation Steps
+ 
+ ### Step 1: Create Font Definitions Module
+ ```pseudocode
+ CREATE emails/styles/fonts.ts
+ DEFINE @font-face rules for:
+   - Proxima Nova (regular weight)
+   - Poppins Black
+   - Additional Poppins variants as needed
+ INCLUDE fallback fonts for email client compatibility
+ EXPORT font family constants
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Step 2: Create Email Font Styles Component
+ ```pseudocode
+ CREATE emails/styles/email-fonts.tsx
+ IMPORT font definitions from fonts.ts
+ CREATE React component that includes:
+   - <style> tag with @font-face definitions
+   - CSS custom properties that map to font families
+   - Fallback font stacks for email clients
+ EXPORT EmailFonts component for use in templates
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Step 3: Update Email Templates
+ ```pseudocode
+ FOR each template in emails/templates/
+   IMPORT EmailFonts component
+   ADD EmailFonts component to template head
+   REPLACE CSS variables with direct font family references:
+     - 'var(--font-proxima-nova)' → 'Proxima Nova, Arial, sans-serif'
+     - 'var(--font-poppins-black)' → 'Poppins Black, Impact, Arial Black, sans-serif'
+   ENSURE proper fallback fonts for email client compatibility
+ END FOR
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Step 4: Handle Incomplete Font Definitions
+ ```pseudocode
+ IDENTIFY templates with incomplete fontFamily properties
+ UPDATE these to use proper font definitions
+ ENSURE no undefined or empty font family values
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Step 5: Create Font Testing Component
+ ```pseudocode
+ CREATE emails/test-font-template.tsx
+ IMPLEMENT template that demonstrates all font styles
+ INCLUDE different weights, sizes, and styles
+ USE for visual verification of font loading
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Step 6: Update Documentation
+ ```pseudocode
+ UPDATE image-cdn-mapping.md
+ ADD section for font usage guidelines
+ DOCUMENT proper font implementation patterns
+ INCLUDE email client compatibility notes
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Font Mapping Strategy
+ ```pseudocode
+ // Current usage → New implementation
+ 'var(--font-proxima-nova)' → 'Proxima Nova, Arial, sans-serif'
+ 'var(--font-poppins-black)' → 'Poppins Black, Impact, Arial Black, sans-serif'
+ 
+ // For email client compatibility
+ INCLUDE web-safe fallbacks in font stacks
+ CONSIDER font-display: swap for performance
+ TEST across major email clients (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail)
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Email Client Considerations
+ ```pseudocode
+ GMAIL: Limited CSS support, prefers inline styles
+ OUTLOOK: Poor web font support, needs strong fallbacks  
+ APPLE_MAIL: Good web font support
+ MOBILE_CLIENTS: Vary in font loading capabilities
+ 
+ STRATEGY:
+   Use inline styles for maximum compatibility
+   Include multiple font formats (woff2, ttf)
+   Provide comprehensive fallback font stacks
+ ```
+ 
+ ## File Structure After Implementation
+ ```
+ emails/
+ ├── styles/
+ │   ├── fonts.ts              # Font definitions and @font-face rules
+ │   ├── email-fonts.tsx       # React component with font styles
+ │   └── index.ts               # Export all styles
+ ├── templates/
+ │   ├── [all existing templates updated]
+ │   └── test-font-template.tsx # Font testing template
+ └── image-cdn-mapping.md       # Updated with font guidelines
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Success Criteria
+ - All email templates load fonts from hosted URLs
+ - Proper fallback fonts ensure compatibility
+ - No broken font references or CSS variables
+ - Visual consistency across email clients
+ - Documentation updated with implementation guidelines

```diff
+ export const EmailFonts: React.FC<EmailFontsProps> = ({

+       --font-poppins: ${FONT_FAMILIES.poppins};
+     }
+     
+     /* Base email styles */
+     body {
+       font-family: ${FONT_FAMILIES.proximaNova};
+       line-height: 1.6;
+       color: #333333;
+     }
+     
+     h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
+       font-family: ${FONT_FAMILIES.poppinsBlack};
+       line-height: 1.2;
+       margin: 0 0 16px 0;

+     p {
+       font-family: ${FONT_FAMILIES.proximaNova};
+       margin: 0 0 16px 0;
+     }
+     
+     a {
+       color: #f7cb00;
+       text-decoration: none;
+     }
+     
+     /* Email client specific overrides */
+     .email-content {
+       font-family: ${FONT_FAMILIES.proximaNova};
+     }
+     
+     .email-heading {
+       font-family: ${FONT_FAMILIES.poppinsBlack};
+     }
+     
+     ${additionalStyles}
+   `
+ 
+   return <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: combinedStyles}} />
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Inline font styles for maximum email client compatibility
```

```diff
+ #!/usr/bin/env node
+ 
+ /**
+  * Script to update all email templates to use hosted fonts instead of CSS variables
+  * Replaces var(--font-*) references with actual font family strings
+  */
+ 
+ const fs = require('fs');
+ const path = require('path');
+ 
+ // Template directory
+ const TEMPLATES_DIR = path.join(__dirname, '../emails/templates');
+ 
+ // Font family mappings
+ const FONT_REPLACEMENTS = [
+   {
+     search: /fontFamily:\s*['"`]var\(--font-proxima-nova\)['"`]/g,
+     replace: "fontFamily: FONT_FAMILIES.proximaNova"
+   },
+   {
+     search: /fontFamily:\s*['"`]var\(--font-poppins-black\)['"`]/g,
+     replace: "fontFamily: FONT_FAMILIES.poppinsBlack"
+   },
+   {
+     search: /color:\s*['"`]var\(--brand-yellow\)['"`]/g,
+     replace: "color: '#f7cb00'"
+   },
+   {
+     search: /backgroundColor:\s*['"`]var\(--brand-yellow\)['"`]/g,
+     replace: "backgroundColor: '#f7cb00'"
+   },
+   {
+     search: /'var\(--brand-yellow\)'/g,
+     replace: "'#f7cb00'"
+   },
+   {
+     search: /'var\(--font-proxima-nova\)'/g,
+     replace: "FONT_FAMILIES.proximaNova"
+   },
+   {
+     search: /'var\(--font-poppins-black\)'/g,
+     replace: "FONT_FAMILIES.poppinsBlack"
+   }
+ ];
+ 
+ // Import statements to add/update
+ const REQUIRED_IMPORTS = {
+   emailFonts: "import {EmailFonts, FONT_FAMILIES} from '../styles'",
+   reactEmail: /from '@react-email\/components'/
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Update imports in a file to include EmailFonts and FONT_FAMILIES
+  */
+ function updateImports(content) {
+   // Check if already has the import
+   if (content.includes("import {EmailFonts, FONT_FAMILIES} from '../styles'")) {
+     return content;
+   }
+ 
+   // Add import after the last react-email import
+   const reactEmailImportMatch = content.match(/(import\s+{[^}]+}\s+from\s+['"`]@react-email\/components['"`])/);
+   
+   if (reactEmailImportMatch) {
+     const importStatement = reactEmailImportMatch[0];
+     return content.replace(importStatement, 
+       importStatement + "\nimport {EmailFonts, FONT_FAMILIES} from '../styles'"
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   // If no react-email import found, add after the first import
+   const firstImportMatch = content.match(/^(import\s+.*?\n)/m);
+   if (firstImportMatch) {
+     return content.replace(firstImportMatch[0], 
+       firstImportMatch[0] + "import {EmailFonts, FONT_FAMILIES} from '../styles'\n"
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return content;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Update Head section to include EmailFonts component
+  */
+ function updateHeadSection(content) {
+   // Pattern 1: <Head /> self-closing
+   if (content.includes('<Head />')) {
+     return content.replace('<Head />', '<Head>\n      <EmailFonts />\n    </Head>');
+   }
+ 
+   // Pattern 2: <Head></Head> empty tags
+   if (content.includes('<Head></Head>')) {
+     return content.replace('<Head></Head>', '<Head>\n      <EmailFonts />\n    </Head>');
+   }
+ 
+   // Pattern 3: <Head> with content but no EmailFonts
+   const headMatch = content.match(/(<Head>)([\s\S]*?)(<\/Head>)/);
+   if (headMatch && !headMatch[2].includes('EmailFonts')) {
+     const [, openTag, headContent, closeTag] = headMatch;
+     return content.replace(headMatch[0], 
+       `${openTag}\n      <EmailFonts />${headContent}${closeTag}`
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return content;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Apply font family replacements to file content
+  */
+ function applyFontReplacements(content) {
+   let updatedContent = content;
+   
+   FONT_REPLACEMENTS.forEach(({ search, replace }) => {
+     updatedContent = updatedContent.replace(search, replace);
+   });
+ 
+   return updatedContent;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Process a single template file
+  */
+ function processTemplate(filePath) {
+   try {
+     console.log(`Processing: ${path.basename(filePath)}`);
+     
+     let content = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8');
+     
+     // Skip files that don't contain React components
+     if (!content.includes('React') && !content.includes('export')) {
+       console.log(`  - Skipped (not a React component)`);
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     // Skip files already updated or test files
+     if (content.includes('FONT_FAMILIES.proximaNova') || 
+         filePath.includes('font-test-template')) {
+       console.log(`  - Skipped (already updated or test file)`);
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     let hasChanges = false;
+     const originalContent = content;
+ 
+     // Update imports
+     content = updateImports(content);
+     if (content !== originalContent) hasChanges = true;
+ 
+     // Update Head section
+     const afterHeadUpdate = updateHeadSection(content);
+     if (afterHeadUpdate !== content) {
+       content = afterHeadUpdate;
+       hasChanges = true;
+     }
+ 
+     // Apply font replacements
+     const afterFontUpdate = applyFontReplacements(content);
+     if (afterFontUpdate !== content) {
+       content = afterFontUpdate;
+       hasChanges = true;
+     }
+ 
+     // Write file if changes were made
+     if (hasChanges) {
+       fs.writeFileSync(filePath, content, 'utf8');
+       console.log(`  ✅ Updated successfully`);
+     } else {
+       console.log(`  - No changes needed`);
+     }
+ 
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error(`  ❌ Error processing ${filePath}:`, error.message);
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Main function to process all templates
+  */
+ function main() {
+   console.log('🚀 Starting email template font updates...\n');
+ 
+   if (!fs.existsSync(TEMPLATES_DIR)) {
+     console.error(`❌ Templates directory not found: ${TEMPLATES_DIR}`);
+     process.exit(1);
+   }
+ 
+   // Get all .tsx files in templates directory
+   const templateFiles = fs.readdirSync(TEMPLATES_DIR)
+     .filter(file => file.endsWith('.tsx'))
+     .map(file => path.join(TEMPLATES_DIR, file));
+ 
+   if (templateFiles.length === 0) {
+     console.log('No .tsx template files found');
+     return;
+   }
+ 
+   console.log(`Found ${templateFiles.length} template files to process:\n`);
+ 
+   // Process each template
+   templateFiles.forEach(processTemplate);
+ 
+   console.log('\n✨ Font update process completed!');
+   console.log('\n📝 Next steps:');
+   console.log('1. Review the updated templates');
+   console.log('2. Test email rendering in preview');
+   console.log('3. Check font loading across email clients');
+ }
+ 
+ // Run the script
+ if (require.main === module) {
+   main();
+ } 
```
